common.serverUnreachable: Could not reach the server. Try again.
common.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts — try again in a minute.

location.searchPlaceholder: Search for a place to move the map
location.dragHint: Drag the map so the pin sits on your door.
location.locateFailed: Couldn't read your location — drag the map to the spot instead.
location.locateUnsupported: This browser won't share your location — drag the map to the spot instead.
location.unavailable: The map can't be loaded right now.

channelHint.in_store: Customers earn cashback at your counter.
channelHint.online: Customers earn cashback on orders placed online.
channelHint.both: Customers earn cashback at the counter and online.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in with your merchant account
auth.noStoreYet: Want to offer cashback at your store?

signup.title: Create your store
signup.subtitle: Offer cashback to customers across the Maldives
signup.phoneInvalid: Enter a 7-digit Maldivian mobile number starting with 7 or 9.
signup.phoneHint: We'll text you a 6-digit code to verify this number.
signup.codeInvalid: That code is not right. Check the SMS and try again.
signup.codeAttemptsExceeded: Too many wrong codes. Request a new one.
signup.verificationExpired: Your verification expired. Start again with your mobile number.
signup.businessNamePlaceholder: Your store's name, as customers see it
signup.businessNameRequired: Enter your business name (at least 2 characters).
signup.emailAlreadyRegistered: This email already has a merchant account. Sign in instead.
signup.afterSignupNote: Next you'll set up your store profile — it goes live once Manfaa approves it.
signup.businessNameDvHint: Shown to shoppers reading Manfaa in Dhivehi. Leave it blank and they see the name above.

setup.title: Set up your store
setup.subtitle: Complete these steps, then submit your store for review
setup.ownerOnlyBody: Only the store owner can complete the setup wizard. Ask the owner to finish setting up the store.
setup.profileSubtitle: How your store appears to customers
setup.categoryHint: Pick the category that best matches your store — customers browse by it.
setup.contactHint: Shown on your public store page so customers can reach you.
setup.locationSubtitle: Customers see the stores closest to them first — a pin is what puts you on that list.
setup.locationOnline: You sell online only, so this is optional. Add a pin if you also have a counter customers can visit.
setup.locationNeeded: Move the map, search for a place, or use your location to drop the pin.
setup.locationLater: You can carry on without a pin and add one later under Settings → Branches.
setup.logoSubtitle: Shown on your store page and on discovery cards
setup.logoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB, between 64 and 4096 pixels per side. You can add or change it later.
setup.logoInvalidType: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
setup.logoTooLarge: That image is over 2 MB — pick a smaller file.
setup.rateSubtitle: The percent of each eligible sale your customers earn
setup.rateFormatError: Enter a percent with up to two decimal places, e.g. 7.50.
setup.rateMaxError: The highest rate available right now is {{max}}.
setup.rateRangeHint: Percent of the eligible amount, up to two decimal places. Allowed range {{min}} to {{max}}.
setup.ratePreviewNote: Fee bands: up to 0.99% cashback → 0.25% fee · 1–1.99% → 0.5% · 2–4.99% → 0.75% · 5% and up → 1%. The platform's fee schedule confirms the exact fee.
setup.termsSubtitle: Tell customers what part of the bill earns cashback
setup.termsPlaceholder: e.g. Cashback on the food total, excluding service charge and delivery.
setup.termsGuidance: Displayed to customers exactly as written. Say what counts and what doesn't — service charge, delivery, gift cards, tobacco… It mirrors your agreement and is never used in computation.
setup.termsRequired: Write your cashback terms before continuing.
setup.reviewSubtitle: Check everything, then send your store to Manfaa for review
setup.reviewNoLocation: No pin — customers won't see you in Nearby
setup.reviewNoLogo: No logo — you can add one later
setup.reviewSubmitNote: After you submit, Manfaa reviews your store. It becomes visible to customers only after approval.
setup.pendingTitle: Your store is being reviewed by Manfaa
setup.pendingBody: We're checking the details you submitted. You'll be able to use the merchant panel as soon as your store is approved.
setup.rejectedBody: Manfaa reviewed your store and sent it back with a note:
setup.notEditable: The setup can't be changed right now — refresh to see the latest status.
setup.supportSameAsContact: Same as the contact number above
setup.supportPhoneHint: This is the number shown to shoppers on your store page. Your contact number is how Manfaa reaches you.
setup.websiteHint: Shown on your store page. Just the address is fine — teaplus.mv.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Decide what each job in your shop may do, then put every account on one of these roles
roles.ownerFrozenTitle: The owner role cannot be edited
roles.ownerFrozenWhy: The owner role always holds everything — a role that could be stripped of staff management is how a store locks itself out of its own account. You can still rename it.
roles.cannotEditOwn: You cannot edit the role you hold yourself — ask an owner.
roles.readOnly: You can read the roles here. Changing them needs permission to manage roles.
roles.nameHint: Your shop's own word for the job — staff see this name.
roles.nameDvHint: Shown while the panel is in Dhivehi. Leave it blank and the name above is used.
roles.catalogueFailed: Could not load the permission list.
roles.notHeldNotice: Greyed-out permissions are ones you do not hold yourself — you can only give a role what you have.
roles.capBody: Delete a role you no longer use before adding another.
roles.deleteBody: This role is gone for good. No account stands on it, so nobody loses access.
roles.deleteBlocked_one: {{count}} account holds this role — move it to another role first.
roles.deleteBlocked_other: {{count}} accounts hold this role — move them to another role first.
roles.inviteHint: You can change this later on this screen.

errors.permission_not_held: You cannot give a role a permission you do not hold yourself.
errors.owner_role_not_delegable: Only an owner can hand out the owner role.
errors.cannot_edit_own_role: You cannot edit the role you hold yourself. Ask an owner to change it.
errors.owner_role_frozen: The owner role's permissions cannot be changed. It can still be renamed.
errors.owner_role_undeletable: The owner role cannot be deleted — every store keeps one.
errors.role_in_use: Staff still stand on this role. Move them to another role first.
errors.role_cap_reached: A store can have at most {{cap}} roles.

gate.title: You do not have access to this screen
gate.body: This screen needs a permission your role does not hold: {{permission}}. Ask an owner at {{store}} to add it.
gate.bodyNone: Your role holds none of the permissions this screen needs. Ask an owner at {{store}} if something here should be yours.

permissions.creditsCustomRate: Set a custom cashback rate on a sale
permissions.settlementsReceiptAdd: Add a payment receipt to a settlement
permissions.unknown: a permission this panel does not recognise yet

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: Panel accounts for your store — every account stands on a role, and the role decides what it can do
staff.lastOwnerLocked: This is the store's last active owner. Give another account the owner role first — otherwise nobody could reach the bank account or add staff.
staff.selfDemoteLocked: You cannot move yourself off the owner role — another owner can do it for you.
staff.selfActiveLocked: You cannot deactivate your own account.
staff.needsStaffEdit: Changing an account needs permission to edit staff.
staff.needsRolesView: Picking a role needs permission to see the store's roles, which your role does not hold. Ask an owner to add it.
staff.rolesLoadFailed: Could not load the roles — changing a role is unavailable right now.
staff.notAssignableHint: Roles holding a permission you do not have cannot be picked.
staff.emailHint: They log in with this email.
staff.tempOnceBody: We only keep a scrambled copy, so this password cannot be shown again. Pass it to {{name}} now; they should change it after their first login.
staff.tempAcknowledge: I have securely shared this password and understand it will not be shown again.

settings.profileSubtitle: What customers see about your store
settings.renameNote: Renaming the store never changes its link — anything you have already shared keeps working.
settings.logoSubtitle: Shown on your public store page and discovery cards
settings.categoryHint: Curated list — customers browse stores by category.
settings.categoryRetired: This category was retired — please choose a new one. Your other changes still save.
settings.channelHint: Controls where you appear in the customer app's discovery sections.
settings.storeNameDvHint: Shown to shoppers reading Manfaa in Dhivehi. Leave it blank and they see your name above. Your public link never changes.
settings.storeNameHint: Your public name. Your store link never changes with it, so anything already shared keeps working.

branches.title: Branches
branches.subtitle: Your locations — a pin is what puts a branch into Nearby discovery in the customer app
branches.empty: No branches yet — add your first location to appear in Nearby discovery.
branches.pinHint: The pin powers Nearby discovery — customers around this spot see your store first. Leave it off and the branch simply won't appear in Nearby.
branches.deleteReferenced: This branch has recorded sales or promotions, so it must stay on file. Stop using it instead.
branches.deleteBody: The branch disappears from discovery and from new sales. A branch that already has recorded sales or promotions cannot be deleted — history must keep resolving.

apiAccess.title: API access
apiAccess.subtitle: Connect your till or online shop so sales reach Manfaa automatically
apiAccess.empty: No credentials yet. Create one when your POS company is ready to connect.
apiAccess.revokeBody: This credential stops working immediately and cannot be restored. Sales already recorded with it are unaffected, and your other credentials keep working. Create a new one to reconnect.
apiAccess.capBody: That is the maximum. Revoke one you no longer use, then create the new one.
apiAccess.partnerHint: A name you will recognise later — it is how this credential is listed, and what you revoke if you change providers.
apiAccess.permissionsIntro: Give only what this partner needs. You can revoke the credential at any time, but permissions cannot be changed afterwards — create a new one instead.

transactionsWrite.label: Record sales
transactionsWrite.hint: Send completed sales so your customers earn cashback.

transactionsReverse.label: Reverse sales
transactionsReverse.hint: Cancel the cashback on a sale that was refunded or voided at the till.

ratesRead.label: Read your current rate
ratesRead.hint: Show today's cashback percentage on the till or checkout screen.

customersLookup.label: Look up customer codes
customersLookup.hint: Check a 6-digit customer code and see a masked name before crediting.

apiAccess.reversalsBody: Without this, a refunded sale keeps its cashback and you still pay for it. Sending reversals is part of your integration agreement.
apiAccess.rateLimited: You have created several credentials in the last hour. Wait a little, then try again — or revoke and reuse an existing one.
apiAccess.storeNotTrading: Your store is not active right now, so new credentials cannot be created. Revoking an existing one still works.
apiAccess.tokenOnceBody: We keep only a scrambled copy, so you will not see this again. Copy it now and hand it to your partner over a channel you trust. If it is lost, revoke this credential and create another.
apiAccess.tokenAcknowledge: I have copied this token and understand it will not be shown again.
apiAccess.guideBody: Your POS company does the technical work: they send each eligible sale with the customer's 6-digit code, and Manfaa computes the cashback. Test everything against the sandbox first — nothing there is real.
apiAccess.sandboxNote: Sandbox credentials are issued by us — ask for a set at

productCategories.title: Product categories
productCategories.subtitle: Set different cashback for product types. Anything not listed earns your standing rate.
productCategories.empty: No product categories yet — every sale earns your standing rate. Add one to exclude it or give it its own rate.
productCategories.nameDvHint: Required — this is what a Dhivehi customer sees on their receipt.
productCategories.modeRateHint: Sales in this category earn their own cashback percent.
productCategories.modeExcludedHint: Sales in this category never earn cashback — even during promotions.
productCategories.rateHint: Percent of the line amount, up to two decimal places. Allowed range {{min}} to {{max}}.
productCategories.ratePercentInvalid: Enter a percent with up to two decimal places, e.g. 2.50.
productCategories.sortHint: Lower numbers appear first in lists.
productCategories.deactivateBody: New sales can no longer be split into this category — anything not listed earns your standing rate. Past sales keep the rate they were priced at. You can reactivate it any time.

creditSplit.toggleHint: Optional — split this sale into your product categories so each part earns its own rate.
creditSplit.editorHint: Split the whole amount across categories. Excluded categories go in too — they earn nothing, but they are still part of the total.
creditSplit.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount of at least MVR 0.01.
creditSplit.mismatchTitle: The lines don't add up to the eligible amount.
creditSplit.mismatchBody: Difference: {{difference}}. Every part of the bill goes in, including the excluded ones — the credit can't be recorded until the two match.
creditSplit.duplicateCategory: This category is already on another line.
creditSplit.unknownCategory: This category is no longer available — pick another.
creditSplit.rateUnknown: Rate preview unavailable — the server still prices this line correctly.
creditSplit.excludedNote: This part earns no cashback — even during promotions — but it still counts toward the total.
creditSplit.promoBeats: The live promotion beats this line's own rate ({{own}}).
creditSplit.previewNote: Estimate — each line is priced separately on the server at the sale time; a promotion's per-customer cap may reduce promo-priced lines.
creditSplit.overrideRate: {{rate}} — your custom rate for this sale.

settlement.title: New settlement
settlement.subtitle: Pay your outstanding cashback and fees, then upload your transfer receipt
settlement.selectLead: Tick the sales you are paying for. Every amount here is what Manfaa has recorded against that sale.
settlement.selectionTotalHint: Credits and any discount are applied on the next step.
settlement.emptyPayable: Nothing to settle right now — payable transactions appear here once their validation window closes.
settlement.reviewLead: Transfer this exact amount from your bank, then upload your receipt on the next step. Nothing exists until you do — these transactions stay payable in the meantime.
settlement.creditAppliedHint: Credit notes from earlier adjustments, netted off this batch.
settlement.discountGrantedHint: Nothing left behind, and every sale under {{days}} days old. We confirm it when you submit your receipt.
settlement.discountNudge: Settle everything outstanding and take {{rate}} off your platform fee
settlement.discountAdvisory: Confirmed when you submit. If a sale passes {{days}} days first, the full fee applies.
settlement.discountAppliedHint: Already taken off the amount due. Your customers' cashback was never reduced.
settlement.discountDeadlineTitle: Your oldest sale stops earning the {{rate}} prompt-payment discount on {{date}}
settlement.discountDeadlineBody: Settle everything outstanding before then and save
settlement.discountReasonEligible: You are getting {{rate}} off your platform fee.
settlement.discountReasonNotAllOutstanding: Settle everything outstanding to earn {{rate}} off your platform fee.
settlement.discountReasonLineTooOld: One or more of these sales is {{days}} days or older, so the prompt-payment discount does not apply.
settlement.discountReasonClockNotStarted: One of these sales has no settlement date on our records, so the prompt-payment discount does not apply. Get in touch and we will fix it.
settlement.discountReasonDisabled: The prompt-payment discount is not running at the moment.
settlement.referenceHint: Quote this on the transfer — it is how we recognise your payment.
settlement.referencePreviewNote: This reference is assigned when you submit your receipt. If the settlement then shows a different one, that is the reference of record.
settlement.noAccountTitle: Transfer details are not published yet
settlement.noAccountBody: Contact Manfaa for the account to pay into. Nothing is lost — come back and submit your receipt once you have transferred.
settlement.walletShort: Not enough to cover this settlement.
settlement.walletSettleFailed: Could not settle from your wallet.
settlement.nothingDueTitle: Your credit covers this in full
settlement.nothingDueBody: There is nothing to transfer. Confirm, and these transactions close against your credit.
settlement.uploadLead: The receipt is what creates the settlement — Manfaa checks it against the transfer before your customers' cashback confirms.
settlement.dropzone: Drag your receipt here, or click to choose a file
settlement.dropzoneHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF — up to 5 MB
settlement.fileTooLarge: That file is over 5 MB. Photograph the slip again at a smaller size, or upload the bank's PDF.
settlement.fileUnsupported: Receipts must be a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF file.
settlement.bankRefHint: The reference or transaction number your bank shows for this transfer.
settlement.bankRefRequired: Enter the reference from your bank.
settlement.amountHint: Exactly what left your account — change it only if you sent a different amount.
settlement.amountInvalid: Enter the amount you transferred, e.g. 1,250.00.
settlement.amountUnder: Less than the amount due. We allocate oldest-first: whatever this does not cover stays payable on this settlement until you pay the rest.
settlement.amountOver: More than the amount due. The surplus becomes wallet credit towards your next settlement.
settlement.duplicateBankRef: You have already submitted a receipt with this bank reference. Check the reference on your bank slip, or open the settlement it belongs to.
settlement.notEligible: Some of these transactions are no longer payable. Go back and choose again.
settlement.successBody: Settlement {{reference}} is with our team. We check your slip against the transfer, then your customers' cashback confirms. Nothing else is needed from you.
settlement.listSubtitle: Batches of outstanding cashback and fees you have settled or are settling
settlement.emptyList: No settlements yet — build one from your outstanding transactions.
settlement.statusVerifyingBody: We're checking your slip against the transfer. Your customers' cashback confirms as soon as it matches.
settlement.statusRejected: Manfaa could not verify your transfer
settlement.statusRejectedBody: This settlement is cancelled and its transactions are payable again. Create a new one with the correct receipt.
settlement.statusSettled: Settled — the rewards on this batch are confirmed.
settlement.statusPartiallySettled: Part of this batch is settled; the rest is still owed.
settlement.statusAwaitingPaymentBody: Manfaa built this batch for you. Transfer the amount due, then upload your receipt here.
settlement.statusCancelled: This settlement was cancelled; its transactions are payable again.
settlement.remainderBody: This batch is still short {{amount}}. Its transactions stay frozen here until it is paid in full — transfer the rest, then upload that receipt.
settlement.receiptAdded: Receipt submitted — Manfaa is verifying it.
settlement.settledTitle: Settled — the rewards on this batch are confirmed
settlement.settledBody: Settlement {{reference}} is closed and funded from your wallet. Nothing else is needed from you.
settlement.chooseBankHint: Sending to your own bank is usually free and same-day.
settlement.chooseBankFirst: Choose a bank above to see where to send it.

credit.backdatedTitle: Backdated sale — this credit is final
credit.backdatedBody: This sale is older than your refund window — once credited it cannot be reversed, and it becomes payable to Manfaa immediately.
credit.backdatedMaybeBody: This sale may be older than your refund window. If it is, once credited it cannot be reversed, and it becomes payable to Manfaa immediately.
credit.backdatedConfirm: I understand: this credit cannot be reversed and is payable now.
credit.backdatedConfirmRequired: Confirm you understand before recording this credit.
credit.backdatedResultBody: This backdated sale skipped the refund window. The customer's cashback is payable to Manfaa immediately, and neither you nor your POS can reverse it — contact Manfaa if it needs correcting.
credit.scanBody: Point the camera at the QR code in the customer's Manfaa app.
credit.scanDenied: Camera access is blocked. Allow the camera in your browser settings, or type the 6-digit code.
credit.scanNoCamera: No camera is available on this device — type the 6-digit code instead.
credit.scanFailed: Could not start the camera. Type the 6-digit code instead.
credit.scanUnreadable: That code isn't a Manfaa customer code. Ask the customer to open their Manfaa app, or type the 6-digit code.
credit.scanManualHint: You can always type the code by hand.
credit.occurredAtHint: Leave this empty to record the sale as right now.
credit.occurredAtNow: This sale will be recorded as right now.
credit.customRateToggleHint: Optional — pay this customer more than your usual rate, just for this sale. Your store's advertised rate is unchanged.
credit.customRateHint: Must be {{rate}} or higher — the rate this sale already earns. You can only pay MORE than your advertised rate, never less, and the customer is told the higher figure.
credit.customRateHintNoRate: Your store has no cashback rate in effect yet — contact Manfaa before crediting customers.
credit.customRateFormat: Enter a percent with up to two decimal places, e.g. 7.50.
credit.customRateTooLow: This sale already earns {{rate}}. A custom rate can only be higher — your advertised rate is a promise to the customer.
credit.customRatePreviewNote: Estimate at your custom rate — the platform fee follows the rate you pay. The server confirms both at the sale time.
credit.customRateRefusedTitle: That rate is lower than this sale already earns.
credit.customRateRefusedBody: This sale earns {{rate}} — your standing rate, or a promotion running right now. A custom rate can only raise it, because the customer was advertised that figure. Enter a higher rate, or switch the custom rate off.
credit.customRateRefusedBodyNoRate: A custom rate can only raise what this sale already earns, because the customer was advertised that figure. Enter a higher rate, or switch the custom rate off.
credit.customRateNotPricedTitle: That rate is not available yet.

transactions.amendBody: Fix what was rung up on {{invoiceNo}}. The cashback is recalculated at the same rate the sale was recorded under.
transactions.amendHint: The part of the bill cashback is computed on, as it should have been.
transactions.cancelBody: {{invoiceNo}} comes off entirely and the cashback is taken back.
transactions.cancelWarning: The customer has already been told they earned this. Cancelling removes it from their balance.
transactions.amendLinesHint: The eligible amount adds up from these lines:

marketing.headline: Bring shoppers back to your store
marketing.subtitle: Manfaa puts your store in front of cashback shoppers across the Maldives — and gives them a reason to come back.
marketing.point1Body: Your store appears in the Manfaa app and on the map, with your cashback rate on the card.
marketing.point2Body: Choose the cashback you offer and change it as your business needs.
marketing.point3Body: Settle what you owe in a few taps — pay early and keep the 5% prompt-payment discount.
marketing.panelTitle: The cashback platform for Maldivian stores
